faq.question: Is this the real Semrush data?
faq.answer: Yes, 100%. You are accessing real Semrush accounts through our secure dashboard. The data, metrics, and features match what you get on an official subscription for the included modules.

faq.question: How do I use the Semrush Toolkit?
faq.answer: Subscribe to a plan that includes the toolkit, install the browser extension from our guide, log in, and you’ll see metrics on Google SERPs and pages you visit.

faq.question: Can I use it on multiple devices?
faq.answer: Plans are built for fair single-session use. You can switch devices, but simultaneous sessions can trigger limits. Use one primary work machine when possible.

faq.question: What happens if a tool goes down?
faq.answer: We monitor 24/7. If an account hits limits or is paused, our system rotates to a healthy seat so downtime is rare and usually brief.

faq.question: Is my search history private?
faq.answer: Yes. Isolation keeps your projects and searches separate from other members in the pool.

faq.question: What are the daily limits?
faq.answer: Limits depend on plan tier. Standard-style access often includes on the order of 30 credits per day for heavy reports. They reset every 24 hours.

faq.question: Do you offer a refund if I'm not happy?
faq.answer: Yes. If something doesn’t work as described early on, contact support. We offer a clear refund window (see checkout terms).

faq.question: How do I pay?
faq.answer: Cards, PayPal, and other methods shown at checkout, all through encrypted providers.

faq.question: Is there any software to download?
faq.answer: Core access is browser-based. Only the optional Semrush Toolkit uses a lightweight extension.

faq.question: How fast is activation?
faq.answer: Most members receive credentials within minutes after payment confirmation.
